$setupFileComment: `vitest.setup.ts` is executed by Vitest for every spec in this project, and until it was listed here no TypeScript project included it: `tsconfig.lib.json` takes `src/**/*.ts` only, and this config listed the Vitest configs but not the setup. So the file that bootstraps the Angular test environment — the one thing every spec here depends on before it runs — was the one file the `spec-types` gate could not see.
